name: Buckwheat Khichdi
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: ⅓ cup whole buckwheat groats, rinsed
¼ cup split moong dal, rinsed
1 tsp ginger and 1 green chilli, minced
1 extra cup non-starchy vegetables (spinach, cabbage or green beans), chopped
steps: Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and add ginger and chilli.
Add the extra chopped vegetables together with the other vegetables.
Add the buckwheat, moong dal, vegetables, turmeric and salt.
Add the water and simmer covered for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft.
note: Buckwheat is not related to wheat and is gluten-free.
